channel.title: 3:17 blog
channel.description: Plain answers about waking in the night during menopause, by Marian Grout, founder of 3:17.

item.title: Should I Get Out of Bed If I Wake at 3am and Can't Fall Back Asleep?
item.description: Should you get out of bed when you can't sleep at 3am? Read the guidance on stimulus control, night sweats and when to ask a clinician for individual advice.

item.title: How Can I Set Up My Bedroom for Night Sweats So I Wake Less and Settle Faster?
item.description: A practical guide to a cool bedroom, layered bedding, bedside cooling and spare nightwear for menopause night sweats, with comfort tips and evidence limits.

item.title: Why Can't I Switch Off My Thoughts When I Wake at Night in Menopause?
item.description: Racing thoughts at night in menopause? Explore the evidence on worry, mood and sleep, plus CBT-I, scheduled worry time and when to speak with a clinician.

item.title: Awake at 3 a.m. and can't get back to sleep? What to do in menopause
item.description: Can't get back to sleep in menopause? Read what NHS guidance and CBT-I research say about night waking, practical next steps, and when to speak with your GP.

item.title: Night Sweats Waking Me Up Every Night: What Are My Options?
item.description: Night sweats waking you up? A balanced look at bedroom changes, diaries, hormone therapy, non-hormonal options and CBT, and how to decide with your clinician.

item.title: Why do I wake at 3 a.m. in menopause?
item.description: Waking at 3 a.m. in menopause? Read what research says about night waking and hot flushes, where the evidence stops, and when to speak with your clinician.
